summary: Mobile-only (375x667) Playwright testing of Phase 2 gap list: onboarding->tutorial->get-started->menu, 7-step frozen tutorial, skip/replay, rig animation/jump/slide/freeze/character colours, /dev-rig, scheduled roof routes, 7 languages + persistence, toast dismissal, revive 5/10 regression, pause/game over/banking/reload. All requested flows PASS. One layout bug fixed (Settings 'Replay tutorial' button collapsed to 0 height on web). Minor issues listed below.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by tester: style {flex:0} on RN-web resolved to flex-basis 0% so the button collapsed to a 4px line with its label overlapping the Help/Privacy/Terms row. Replaced with flexGrow:0/flexShrink:0/flexBasis:'auto' -> now 351x48.

integration_issues.issue: Interval uses spawn-time projected speed, so the 1st->2nd scheduled roof route gap was ~10 s of game time (z=306 -> z=433 m, speed ~12 m/s), below the 15-25 s spec. Later gaps were ~14.5, 17, 20 s. Observed roof z: 306,433,625,894,1243,1625,2174,2600.

issues: 'Double-tap: board x3' hint is shown in the tutorial even though double-tap is disabled there; on the right it is partly hidden behind/under the coin pill and has low contrast over the buildings
Dev FPS text (green) overlaps the power-up timer pill when a power-up is active (dev only)
Long translated labels (e.g. கதாபாத்திரங்கள்) render very small inside the square buttons; consider allowing 2 lines or a min font size
At 375px width only 6 of the 16 pose columns are visible and there is no horizontal scroll (full 6x16 grid confirmed at 1920px). Dev only.
The 'Shadow' character (black outfit, dark head) has low contrast on the dark navy track/background

test_report_links: .screenshots/ (tut_hint, tut_done, getstarted, run_0..2, jump, slide, roof_sched, roof_end, zoe_run, devrig_wide, revive1, revive2, menu_ta, settings_replay)
action_items: Roof schedule: compute the next-roof gap from the speed the runner will have when reaching the row (or use time), so the first gap after 30 s is >=15 s
Hide the 'Double-tap: board' HUD hint in the tutorial and fix its overlap/contrast with the coin pill
Optional: improve long translated labels on the menu square buttons; make /dev-rig horizontally scrollable on narrow screens; raise Shadow character contrast (rim light/outline)
critical_code_review_comments: tutorial.tsx: the onExit replay path uses router.back() only when canGoBack(); otherwise it goes to /get-started, so a replay opened by deep link /tutorial?replay=1 after a reload shows get-started. That is acceptable.
Deep-link reload (e.g. /collection/boards) keeps the save but BootGate lands on /menu, not the original route. Not a regression, just noting it.
RunScreen __RR_DEBUG__ now also exposes a dev-only 'engine' getter (added by tester for roof-route inspection)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass (1 layout bug fixed, 1 minor spec deviation in roof interval)

seed_data_creation: None; each browser context started fresh in onboarding
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh contexts start in onboarding: next-welcome -> age-over13 -> accept-terms -> name -> next-name -> next-how -> claim-gift -> /tutorial. Use tutorial-skip-button -> get-started-button to reach the menu quickly. Onboarding language chips are onboarding-lang-<id>, and the Settings ones are language-<id>. Menu buttons are menu-*-button. To find scheduled roof rows, use window.__RR_DEBUG__.engine.obstacles.items and group active non-moving trains by z (3 per row, with ramp=true on at least one). The first roof is at about z=305 m. Revive panel text is animated, so read it with textContent instead of inner_text.
rca_of_issue: Replay tutorial collapse: on react-native-web, flex:0 expands to flex:0 0 0%. In a column ScrollView content container the height:48 is then overridden by the 0 basis. Fix: use flexBasis:'auto'.
